notes: Ranges the probe found occupied by its own process image are NOT recorded as host limitations; see probe_run.warnings.

warnings: translation_mode was not probed in v0.1 and is reported as unknown rather than assumed to be 'none'
a hint above DEFAULT_MAP_WINDOW does not change what this host will reserve (0x400000000000 either way), so max_single_reservation means what it says here. On a host with 5-level paging it would not

kernel's mmap allocation arena [0x7c0000000000, 0x7ffffffff000) sampled every 0x1000000000 bytes: 65 granted, 0 already held by the probe process, 0 structurally refused. The first two are treated identically on purpose; only the third is a host limitation

ET_DYN base region, where a position-independent executable is placed [0x550000000000, 0x590000000000) sampled every 0x1000000000 bytes: 65 granted, 0 already held by the probe process, 0 structurally refused. The first two are treated identically on purpose; only the third is a host limitation
